annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2015/27 on the publication with a restriction of the reference of standard EN 474-1:2006+A4:2013 on Earth-moving machinery under Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2015/27 on the publication with a restriction of the reference of standard EN 474-1:2006+A4:2013 on Earth-moving machinery under Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 4/24
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision requiring that the reference of harmonised standard EN 474-1:2006+A4:2013 on earth-moving machinery be published with a restriction, because its operator visibility clause fails Machinery Directive essential safety requirements after fatal accidents. Concerns conventional machinery, not AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reference of EN 474-1:2006+A4:2013 published in OJEU with a restriction
Clause 5.8.1 (operator's field of view) gives no presumption of conformity with EHSR 1.2.2 and 3.2.1
Decision prompted by petitions on fatal accidents from insufficient visibility
Enters into force on the twentieth day after publication
